product.officialTitle: Adults' and kids' ski and snowboard helmet FS 300

specifications.fitSystem: Turnring adjustment wheel; adjustable chin strap and occipital adjustment
specifications.lens: No visor; compatible with glasses and ski goggles
specifications.fitNote: Choose usual size; official page says FS 300 forehead is slightly shorter than other Wedze helmets, so try it on.
specifications.safety: Replace after any impact. Maximum recommended use is 5 years from manufacture if there has been no serious impact. Thick hats and adding a camera may affect safety.
specifications.season: The official page identifies winter season but does not confirm a product snow-year. 2026 in the seed is a collection label only.

price.caveat: UK regional converted reference, not a China retail price; shipping, taxes and exchange spread are excluded.
